title: 50bb multi-size exact flop pilot · not a serving model
description: Bounded complete flop-to-river research game on Qs 9h 6c with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. Unlike the high-pot smoke pilot, this retains non-all-in half-pot and pot bets, raises, subsequent betting and every legal public runout.
rangeAssumptions: Illustrative seven-combo ranges on each side, equal per-combo weights: BTN QQ/T8s, BB 99/JTs. These deliberately narrow ranges test implementation and computation, not broad strategic coverage or certified earlier-street policies. Rake-free Home game.
